description: A white paper cup sits on the bed in front of you, with a toothbrush and a small toothpaste tube nearby. The right hand reaches into the cup to take the toothbrush and brings it toward the center, while the left hand picks up the toothpaste tube; the left hand aims the tube’s nozzle over the toothbrush bristles as the right hand holds the toothbrush steady, squeezing out toothpaste onto the bristles before easing the tube back.
